boundaries.cli_stdout: Actual saved stdout.bin byte length, not reconstructed response text
boundaries.cli_process_wall: subprocess.run creation through exit/reap; QA wrapper recording and final delivery excluded
boundaries.request_file: Actual broker REQUEST.json bytes including JSON escaping and final LF
boundaries.serialized_arguments: Compact sorted ASCII-escaped JSON of request args without terminal LF
boundaries.code: Native code UTF-8 bytes before JSON escaping; included inside serialized args and request bytes
boundaries.query_literal: Exact query-literal CLI argument UTF-8 bytes; overlaps argument/request representation
boundaries.broker: Actual public data/control/wire byte counters; consumer and operator close separated
boundaries.worker: RPC count from retained WORKER_EVENTS, attributed by broker monotonic time intervals
boundaries.public_calls: Neutral broker reserved native/observe/other operations. Host exec and local file operations are outside this count and unenumerated.
boundaries.timing: Sibling calls summed within a scope. CLI/broker/thin/worker/product and chain wall are nested and never added
boundaries.model_delivery: Host wrapper/model consumed bytes, provider requests and fees unmeasured
boundaries.tool_description: 959-byte original description explicitly inserted once into each P initial prompt; two total insertions. Provider context retransmission and cache frequency unmeasured
boundaries.direct_adoption: Native after measured pair_relation is a sequence marker. Raw code and response sufficiency support separate completion/adoption review
boundaries.product_work: exact_pair_count, pair_cache_hit and selected_capture count only product audit/capture paths; native geometric algorithms are not instrumented.
boundaries.selected_capture: Exact HUMAN_EYE_BLENDER_MCP protocol result frames from underlying product capture call stdout, cross-referenced with product COST.native_private_evidence.

preparation.preparation_time_scope: First chain start minus actual root turn start, contains nested preparation activities. Author work continuing during chains is not isolated CPU cost.
